target_labels.throughput_over_clear_weather_p95: arrival throughput (AAR proxy) over clear-weather ceiling
target_labels.departure_delay_gt45: severe departure delay (>45 min, operated flights)

metric_definitions.recall_at_precision: best recall on the scored rows' own curve, a summary and not an operating point: its threshold is not frozen in advance
metric_definitions.pooled: rows weighted equally: by flight for flight tasks, by airport-hour for airport tasks, so airport tasks are not volume-weighted. At horizon all, each target counts once per horizon
metric_definitions.macro: unweighted mean over every configured airport, null unless all are defined
metric_definitions.common_support: rows where every model active in the slice gave an estimate, decided over the whole slice, so pooled and all-horizon rows share one row set
metric_definitions.baseline_support: rows the model and both required baselines all scored; skill is measured only here
metric_definitions.operational_day: 24 h from 08:00 UTC, near the overnight traffic trough
metric_definitions.weather_slices: weather:<flag>, weather:not_<flag> and weather:<flag>_unknown (no METAR in the hour) from eval_weather_slices, joined on airport and floor(target_start_utc, 1 h); common-support rows, all horizons together

weather_slices.use: evaluation only, realised target-hour weather; never a predictor
